Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Chelsea

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Chelsea. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

Chelsea sits close to the water, so we know what salt air and wind do to metal roofs, flashings and gutters, and we recommend materials that stand up to it. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Chelsea: What We Commonly See

Chelsea is a flat, low-lying beachside suburb with a long stretch of foreshore, and its housing is mostly post-war brick and older period homes. Many still have their original roofs, now faded and weathered after decades of sun and salt, alongside newer metal re-roofs.

Being so close to the bay, salt air is a constant in Chelsea, corroding metal roofs, ridge capping fixings, valleys and gutters faster than inland. The jobs we see most here are rusted gutters and valleys, cracked and lifted ridge capping, and leaks where flashings have failed.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Chelsea

When a roof has reached the end of its life, replacing it is the smarter long-term spend. We re-roof Chelsea homes in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, strong and well suited to bayside weather, and we use quality fixings, flashings and gutters that stand up to salt air.

Thinking about going metal? We also handle tile to tin conversions, swapping a heavy, high-maintenance roof for lightweight metal. If your roof has widespread leaks, sagging or badly rusted sheeting, talk to us about a re-roof before you keep paying for patch jobs. We will give you a straight answer on what makes the most sense for your home and budget.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Chelsea

Our registered roof plumbers look after the parts of the roof that take the most punishment near the water: flashings, valleys, ridge capping, box gutters and downpipes. Salt air eats through poorly finished metal quickly, so we trace leaks back to the real source and fix them properly rather than patching the ceiling stain.

Whether you need one section of guttering replaced or a full re-gutter with matching downpipes in COLORBOND® steel, we will quote it clearly and finish it neatly. Small jobs such as gutter repairs are no problem either.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Chelsea

Every roof is different, so we quote on what is actually in front of us rather than a one-size-fits-all price. The main things that move the cost are the size and pitch of the roof, the roofing material you choose, how much guttering and flashing is involved, and how easy the roof is to access safely. We will walk you through exactly what your quote covers so there are no surprises.

Our Chelsea Roofing Process

It starts with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. Once you approve it we strip the existing roof, check and prepare the framing, then install new COLORBOND® steel sheeting, flashings and ridge capping, along with new guttering and downpipes where they are part of the job. Every job finishes with a clean site.

Why Chelsea Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

Chelsea locals choose Sandhurst Roofing because we turn up when we say we will, do quality work and charge a fair price. We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, and we explain what is happening every step of the way. Have a look at the COLORBOND® colour chart to start choosing your colour.

Chelsea Roofing FAQs

Does living near the bay affect my roof?

Yes. Salt air corrodes metal roofs, fixings, flashings and gutters faster than it does inland, so coastal homes benefit from quality COLORBOND® materials and regular checks.

How long does a re-roof take?

Most homes are completed in a few days, weather depending. We will give you a realistic timeframe with your quote.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.

Suburbs We Service Near Chelsea

We also work on roofs in nearby Aspendale, Bonbeach, Edithvale, Mordialloc, Chelsea Heights and Carrum.
